name: gdip
description: Guest Demand Intelligence Platform — market research for luxury NH short-term rentals.

gdip.note: Phase 1 (data spine + Airbnb ingestion slice). The Firecrawl SDK (@mendable/firecrawl-js) and Anthropic SDK are added in their phases; Phase 1 keeps the Firecrawl call behind an injectable HTTP-ish interface so parsing/dedup/filtering logic is testable without network or keys. Next.js dashboard is scaffolded in Phase 4.
